locations.note: Hosts the Laguna Seca 200 Miles endurance race, and is where Top Gear's Jeremy Clarkson pitted a real lap of the circuit against a GT4 lap.
New to the series in GT4, in two 2005 layouts, with and without the Mulsanne chicanes, each with its own 24-hour endurance race.
Raced as it looked in the 1980s, the 1990s and 2005, with a separate GT layout of the 2005 track, and home to the Fuji 1000 km endurance race.
Makes its series debut as Infineon Raceway, in both its Sports Car and Stock Car layouts, and hosts the Infineon World Sports endurance event.
The Nordschleife makes its series debut in GT4, with both a 4-hour and a full 24-hour endurance race.
New to the series in GT4, with the full circuit plus the East and West courses, and the Suzuka 1000 km endurance race.
Offered in dry and wet versions and home to the Tsukuba 9 Hours endurance race.
Twin Ring Motegi joins the series with four layouts, the road course, East and West short courses and the oval Superspeedway, plus the Motegi 8 Hours.
